title: 第1181章 道貌岸然第1180章 暗色印记
slug: 开局一枚玉佩凡女低调修仙
lines: 苏月不断变换法诀，引导液体将中心凹槽完全封闭。
随最后一道法印落下，整个物件爆发一次轻微的灵力激荡。
一块特制的寻源阵盘终于大功告成。
阵盘通体呈现深邃的幽黑色，表面银色符文流转着神秘光泽。
正中心封印着暗红色罪证。内部缓缓游动。
苏月吐出一口浊气，整个人无力靠在桌案上。
双手布满烫伤，衣衫早被汗水湿透，显得狼狈不堪。
萧玄走上前，拿起探查罗盘，仔细端详。
能清晰感知，内部寻源法阵正平稳运转。
只要将此物靠近方圆十丈之内，一旦感知到同源的双系真气，表面银色符文便会爆发出红光，并发出高频震动。
这是无可辩驳的绝对铁证。
“你此次立下大功。双手伤势，我定赐九转玉露膏为你生肌续骨。”
萧玄将阵盘郑重收入戒指中，眼底满是志在必得的阴寒杀机。
苏月虚弱拱手：“多谢赏赐。能协助炼成此物，总算没有辜负栽培。”
萧玄转过身，负手而立，目光望向大殿外深邃夜空。
“明日清晨，敲响聚将钟。命所有元婴期长老，及各堂首座，即刻前往主殿议事。”
“就说矿区遭遇不明散修袭击，损失惨重，需商议应对之策。”萧玄的声音冰冷肃杀。
这道指令，便是一张精心编织的罗网。
刑罚长老刘仪作为核心高层，必定会出席这场最高级别会议。
届时，萧玄只需将阵盘藏于袖中。叛徒跨入大殿之时，物件的反应，便会彻底宣判死刑。
苏月站在后方，安静看着前方背影。
寻源法器已炼制完毕。
接下来，便是见证这位权势滔天的叛徒，如何一步步踏入精心设计的死局。
只需继续扮演重伤未愈的看客，完美隐藏在这场即将爆发的权力倾轧与血腥清洗之外。
清晨，灵虚派主峰顶端传来沉闷的钟声。
聚将钟接连敲响九次，雄浑的音波穿透云层，向着四面八方的山峰扩散。
这是门派遭遇重大变故、召集所有高层议事的最高指令。
主殿内部，数十盏长明灯将宽阔的空间照得通明。
萧玄端坐于正前方的紫金宝座之上，面容威严，双目微闭。
宽大的紫金道袍袖口自然垂落，右手中暗中握着昨夜炼制完成的寻源阵盘。
苏月换上了一身内门执事的寻常服饰，收敛周身气息，低垂着眼眸，安静地站在宝座侧后方的阴影之中。
她将自身的存在感降到了最低限度，神识却悄然外放，笼罩着大殿入口的方位。
伴随着沉稳的脚步声，门派内的高层长老们开始陆续跨入大殿。
首先走进殿内的是掌管丹药堂的李长老。此人拥有元婴初期修为，主修火系功法。
李长老迈过高高的门槛，带着一身浓郁的药香与温热气息，走到大殿中央，对着萧玄躬身行礼。
萧玄微微点头，神识集中在袖中的寻源阵盘上。
阵盘表面平稳安静，内部封印的那缕暗红色罪证没有任何异动。
李长老并非内鬼。
紧接着，传功堂赵长老、灵兽堂孙长老等人先后进入大殿。
这些皆是门派中掌握实权、修为达到元婴境界的顶尖战力。
他们按照各自的座次依次落座，神情皆带着几分疑惑与凝重，互相低声交谈，猜测着聚将钟敲响的缘由。
苏月站在后方，冷眼旁观。
content_en:
Su Yue constantly changed the techniques, guiding the liquid to completely seal the central groove.
As the last seal fell, the entire object erupted with a slight spiritual surge.
A specially made source-seeking array plate was finally completed.
The entire formation disk is a deep, dark black, and the silver runes on the surface are flowing with a mysterious luster.
The dark red evidence of guilt is sealed in the center. Slowly swimming inside.
Su Yue let out a breath of turbid air and leaned on the table helplessly.
His hands were covered with burns, and his clothes were soaked with sweat, making him look miserable.
Xiao Xuan stepped forward, picked up the exploration compass, and looked at it carefully.
It can be clearly sensed that the internal source-seeking array is operating smoothly.
As long as the object is brought within a radius of ten feet, once the dual-system infuriating energy from the same source is sensed, the silver runes on the surface will burst into red light and emit high-frequency vibrations.
This is irrefutable and absolute ironclad evidence.
"You have made a great contribution this time. If your hands are injured, I will definitely give you Jiuzuan Jade Dew Cream to build muscles and bones."
Xiao Xuan solemnly put the formation disk into the ring, his eyes full of cold murderous intent to win.
Su Yue weakly handed over her hand: "Thank you for the reward. Being able to help refine this thing, I finally lived up to my cultivation."
Xiao Xuan turned around, stood with his hands behind his back, and looked at the deep night sky outside the hall.
"Tomorrow morning, ring the gathering bell. Order all Yuanying stage elders and the heads of each hall to go to the main hall immediately to discuss matters."
"Let's just say that the mining area was attacked by unknown rogue cultivators and suffered heavy losses. We need to discuss countermeasures." Xiao Xuan's voice was cold and solemn.
This instruction is a carefully woven net.
As the core senior executive, Punishment Elder Liu Yi will definitely attend this highest-level meeting.
At that time, Xiao Xuan only needs to hide the formation plate in his sleeve. When the traitor steps into the hall, the reaction of the object will be a complete sentence of death.
Su Yue stood at the back, quietly looking at the back in front of her.
The source-seeking magic weapon has been refined.
Next, we will witness how this powerful traitor steps into a carefully designed death situation.
Just continue to play the role of a spectator who has not recovered from his serious injury, perfectly hiding from the power struggle and bloody purge that is about to break out.
In the early morning, a dull bell sounded from the top of the main peak of Lingxu Sect.
The Jujiang Bell rang nine times in succession, and the powerful sound waves penetrated the clouds and spread to the mountain peaks in all directions.
This is the highest order for the sect to convene all high-level discussions when encountering major changes.
Inside the main hall, dozens of ever-burning lamps illuminate the vast space.
Xiao Xuan sat on the purple gold throne directly in front, with a majestic face and slightly closed eyes.
The sleeves of the wide purple gold Taoist robe hung down naturally, and in his right hand he secretly held the source-seeking array plate that was refined last night.
Su Yue put on the ordinary clothes of an inner sect deacon, restrained her aura, lowered her eyes, and stood quietly in the shadow behind the throne.
She reduced her presence to a minimum, but her consciousness quietly spread out, covering the entrance to the hall.
Following the steady sound of footsteps, the senior elders of the sect began to enter the hall one after another.
The first person to enter the hall was Elder Li, who was in charge of the elixir hall. This person has the early stage of Nascent Soul cultivation and majors in fire-based exercises.
Elder Li stepped over the high threshold, walked to the center of the hall with a strong medicinal fragrance and warm breath, and bowed to Xiao Xuan.
Xiao Xuan nodded slightly, his consciousness focused on the source-seeking array disk in his sleeve.
The surface of the array disk was smooth and quiet, and there was no movement in the dark red evidence sealed inside.
Elder Li is not a mole.
Immediately afterwards, Elder Zhao from the Chuan Gong Hall, Elder Sun from the Spiritual Beast Hall and others entered the main hall one after another.
These are the top combat forces in the sect who hold real power and have reached the Nascent Soul realm.
They sat down in order according to their respective seats, with a bit of confusion and solemn expressions on their faces, talking to each other in low voices, and guessing the reason why the gathering bell was ringing.
Su Yue stood behind and watched coldly.
